Admission moves through vouching. Three established keys must sign a newcomer, each key holds five vouch slots for life, and every signature locks 600 POA that burns when the vouched key later clusters with its signers. Slots never refill, so the graph tightens as it grows.

Fifty clones need 150 signatures, hence 30 established keys, each carrying 36 hours of standing from six answered epochs and 18,000 POA bonded between them. Vouch farms spiral once standing is rentable.

A harbor pilot signs a ship in on three pilots' word, and a crystal grows only where a single seed lattice starts.
